thread:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Starting staged rollout v3.4.1 -> 10% traffic (eu-west5 primary). Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Canary window 10m. Route policy=latency-first.

sam: copying observability folks — watch p95 and 5xx. ping if anything odd.

maria: @sam seeing p95 jump in eu-west5 already. small sample but consistent across shards.

maria: metrics snapshot:
```
svc-inference.eu-west5 p95: 920ms
5xx rate: 0.8% -> 3.6% (3m)
top error: KVCacheOOM -> repeated eviction failures
```

alex: can we pause the canary in eu-west5? i can flip traffic to 0% for that region.

ops-kate: standing by to pause. if we pause now we keep other regions moving? current rollout target is global 10% but all traffic in this batch routes primarily to eu-west5.

sam: pause it. prioritize safety. pin eu-west5 to v3.4.0 and hold global rollout.

ops-kate: applying pin -> `/deploy pin traffic v3.4.0 --region eu-west5`

deploy-bot: Action taken: rollout paused for v3.4.1. eu-west5 pinned to v3.4.0. Current global rollout: 10% -> PAUSED.

alex: good call. any idea root cause? KVCacheOOM sounds like kvcache sizing regression in the new runtime kernels.

maria: logs show increased mem churn during attention cache populate. small batches amplify it.

nina: product question: surface-level customer impact? are any requests failing user-facing or falling into degraded mode?

maria: small percentage of requests seeing 5xx, mainly longer prompts >1024 tokens. impact low but unacceptable.

devex: please add a short note to release notes: "HOT FIX: paused rollout due to canary latency/5xx in eu-west5; investigation ongoing." I can push the edit.

sam: ops/eng decide: do we pin and iterate on fix in v3.4.1 or full rollback to v3.4.0 globally? pros/cons?

alex: my risk take: we should roll back globally to v3.4.0 while we root cause — quicker and avoids cross-region regressions.

ops-kate: prepping rollback runbook. estimating 3-5min to complete global rollback once triggered.

sam: ok initiate global rollback to v3.4.0. notify customer-facing folks.

ops-kate: running command:
```
/deploy rollback v3.4.1 --to v3.4.0 --scope all-regions --confirm
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job started (id=rb-2105554321). Draining canary shards, routing new traffic to v3.4.0. Notifying infra.

maria: monitoring... p95 trending down already in eu-west5. 5xx rate decreasing.

deploy-bot: Rollback job update: 60% of traffic on v3.4.0, eu-west5 routing stable.

ops-kate: rollback complete. traffic 100% on v3.4.0 globally. canary halted.

deploy-bot: [COMPLETE] Rollback finished. Job rb-2105554321 closed. No active rollout for v3.4.1.

sam: thanks. good fast decision. next steps: 1) postmortem doc (owner: maria), 2) add regression test for long prompts + kvcache under quantized kernels (owner: alex), 3) mark v3.4.1 blocked until fixes.

nina: product will prepare customer comms if we see any escalations. adding note to status page. :thumbsup:

devex: updated release notes with short paused/rollback entry and link to thread.

maria: I'll capture logs and start a deep-dive. tagging SRE and runtime teams.

sam: nice coordination. follow-up sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC to review RCA. :white_check_mark:
